The '''Training Grounds''' were an area on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The [[Imperial Guard Academy]] was built by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] at the center of this area. During the [[Revanite crisis]], the Training Grounds were taken over by the [[Order of Revan]] and were protected by [[Lance Squadron (Revanites)|Lance Squadron]] and a large number of troops.<ref name="SWTOR" /> Later, during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Talos Drellik]] established a camp in the area to study the [[Temple of Sacrifice]] nearby.<ref name="KotFE">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=general|Fighting Power With Knowledge|Yavin 4}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Training Grounds appears as an area on Yavin 4 in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />
